newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures up but off highs, sterling driven.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures up but off highs, sterling driven.

text.p: LIFFE grain futures ended firm, but off highs, as the market was borne along by sterling's progress against other European currencies, traders said.
Early weakness pushed prices up, but a sterling recovery later in the day trimmed gains, traders said.
May was most active, with 272 out of a total of 565 lots traded. May last traded 0.30 stg up at 96.50 stg.
But May's high, earlier in the day, had been at at 97.10 stg. "After sterling picked up the buyers didn't want to know," one trader said.
